_comment: Word banks and sentence-frame templates for the fully-procedural floor narrative generator (scripts/lib/level-gen/StoryGenerator.mjs, JournalBuilder.mjs). Templates use {slot} placeholders filled from this same category's other arrays, so output stays thematically consistent rather than mad-lib random. Add a themeCategory here and it's immediately available via data/floors-manifest.json's themeCategory field.

arcTemplates: {threat} sealed something down here that was never meant to finish brewing, and the seals are failing.
A formula for {threat} to end all suffering - or all resistance - was hidden in the {domain} below, and someone just found the first ingredient.
{threat} has been using this floor to distill something out of captives who never leave.
subStoryTemplates: A cache of unstable reagents is destabilizing nearby rooms and needs to be found before it detonates.
One of {threat}'s apprentices wants out and has been leaving coded warnings for anyone who'll listen.
A half-transmuted survivor is trapped between forms in a side chamber, begging for the process to be reversed or finished.
The floor's water supply has been dosed with a reagent that's slowly changing everything that drinks it.
friendlyNpcHooks: A former apprentice of {threat} who fled mid-formula and has been hiding here ever since, desperate for someone to finish what they started - or stop it.
A half-transmuted survivor, more lucid than they look, who knows the layout of {threat}'s workshops better than anyone still willing to talk about them.

arcTemplates: {threat} never got the burial it was owed, and it intends to make everyone still breathing understand why that matters.
Something in the {domain} below is calling the recently dead home, one grave at a time.
{threat} has been rebuilding an army out of everyone who's ever died on this floor - including, eventually, the party.
subStoryTemplates: A restless spirit will not move on until an old debt, owed for generations, is finally settled.
Grave robbers hired by someone topside are already down here, and they know things about the layout the party doesn't.
A single still-living prisoner has been kept alive for decades as a witness to something {threat} doesn't want forgotten - or remembered.
Bones are going missing from sealed tombs, one at a time, in a pattern that spells out a name.
friendlyNpcHooks: The single still-living prisoner {threat} has kept as a witness for decades, finally free enough to talk if someone will listen.
A grave robber who turned back after seeing what {threat} does to the freshly dead, and hasn't stopped feeling watched since.

arcTemplates: {threat} bound a piece of the raw elemental plane into this floor's foundations, and the binding is cracking room by room.
The {domain} below were built to contain {threat} - they were never built to contain it forever.
{threat} is trying to widen a rift that's already reshaping the floor's geography one tremor at a time.
subStoryTemplates: A containment ward is failing in a side chamber and someone needs to re-anchor it before the whole floor destabilizes.
Local wildlife has been mutating near the rift and is now aggressively territorial in ways it wasn't before.
An engineer who helped build the original wards left instructions for shutting it all down - if anyone can find them.
{threat} has agents already on this floor trying to accelerate the breach rather than stop it.
friendlyNpcHooks: The engineer who helped build the original containment wards, still down here trying to finish the shutdown alone.
A refugee from a deeper level fleeing {threat}'s spreading rift, grateful for company and full of warnings.

threats: a splinter sect of the Hollow Star
arcTemplates: {threat} has been using this floor's {domain} for a ritual that requires exactly one more willing - or unwilling - participant.
{threat} believes something asleep beneath the {domain} is a god, and they intend to wake it whether or not that's true.
A schism inside {threat} has turned this floor into a battleground between two versions of the same faith.
subStoryTemplates: A captured initiate wants to defect and can name every trap between here and the inner sanctum - for a price.
Ritual components are being smuggled in from the surface, and cutting off the supply would stall the whole plan.
One of {threat}'s own has started having doubts and is leaving evidence behind, half hoping to be stopped.
A relic central to the ritual has already been stolen by someone with their own agenda, and neither side has noticed yet.
friendlyNpcHooks: A captured initiate of {threat} who wants to defect and can name every trap between here and the inner sanctum - for a price.
One of {threat}'s own, quietly having doubts, who's been leaving evidence behind half hoping someone will stop this.

threats: something that was never meant to breed this fast
arcTemplates: {threat} has claimed the {domain} below as territory, and it's been expanding its range every season since.
Something in the {domain} triggered a breeding surge, and {threat} now controls far more ground than any survey accounts for.
{threat} isn't hostile by nature - it's defending a nest, and anyone who reaches it uninvited won't get a warning.
subStoryTemplates: A trapper who knows the den layout will trade that knowledge for help freeing a snared partner.
Something is picking off {threat}'s own brood one at a time, and it isn't the party.
A previous expedition's survivor has been living off the land down here long enough to have gone a little feral themselves.
The nest's growth is undermining a structural support that could collapse a much larger section of the floor.
friendlyNpcHooks: A trapper who knows the den layout and will trade that knowledge for help freeing a snared partner.
A previous expedition's survivor who's lived off this land long enough to have gone a little feral themselves, but still remembers how to talk.

threats: something that predates the floor itself
a presence with no true name
arcTemplates: {threat} was sealed in the {domain} long before this floor was ever mapped, and the seal was never meant to last this long.
{threat} doesn't want anything from the party - it wants them to stop looking, and it's willing to rearrange the floor to make that happen.
Something about the {domain} below makes maps stop matching the territory, and {threat} is the reason why.
subStoryTemplates: A previous survey team's final log entries describe something that shouldn't be believed - and shouldn't be ignored either.
A sealed door has no lock, no hinges, and no explanation, and something on the other side has started answering knocks.
One party member's dreams have started including rooms that don't exist yet on this floor's map - until they do.
{threat} has been testing the wards a little more each night, and tonight is the first time one of them didn't hold.
friendlyNpcHooks: The sole survivor of a previous expedition's final log entries, alive but changed by however long they've spent near {threat}.
Someone whose dreams started including rooms that don't exist on this floor's map yet - until they do - and who wants that to stop.

threats: a goblin war-band that's crowned a llama as their living god
the Wool-Crowned King and his stolen throne of saddlebags
a llama cavalry that never agreed to be a cavalry
two goblin chiefs feuding over which of them the llamas actually like better
arcTemplates: {threat} has turned the {domain} into equal parts throne room and petting zoo, and nobody currently in charge can explain how that happened.
Somewhere in the {domain}, {threat} is handing out promotions based entirely on who the llamas nuzzle first.
{threat} started as a joke - a goblin sat on a llama once, on a dare - and now it's the closest thing this warren has to a government.
subStoryTemplates: A goblin quartermaster is trying to smuggle out the good llama, the one that doesn't spit on command, before the war-band notices it's gone.
Two rival goblin chiefs have agreed to settle their feud with a llama race down the main hall - and both have been caught trying to bribe the same llama.
One llama has figured out that spitting on goblins gets it double rations, and has started training the others.
A goblin who fell off a llama during the coronation still hasn't lived it down, and is looking for literally anyone new to tell the story to.
friendlyNpcHooks: A goblin cook who's stopped asking questions about the chain of command as long as somebody keeps bringing hay.
A llama who wandered in from a passing caravan months ago and has since - through no effort of its own - become a folk hero.

entrance: The way down opens into a {adj} chamber, the air already carrying a trace of what waits deeper in the {domain}.
This landing marks the last point where retreat is still simple - past here, the {domain} close in.
corridor-junction: Passages fork here into the {adj} heart of the {domain}, worn smooth by traffic that wasn't always living.
A junction of old routes, {adj} enough that it's clearly seen more use than the maps suggest.
treasure-vault: A {adj} strongroom, its contents undisturbed long enough to have accumulated a history of their own.
Whatever was worth sealing away in this {adj} vault, someone judged it worth more than easy access.
secret-vault: Hidden behind a wall no casual search would find, this {adj} chamber was never meant to be entered twice.
A concealed vault, {adj} and undisturbed - whoever built it wanted it forgotten, not just locked.
boss-arena: The {domain} open into a {adj} hall built - or reshaped - around whatever now claims it as its own.
This is clearly the heart of the floor: {adj}, deliberately spacious, and unmistakably occupied.
hazard-chamber: A {adj} room whose original purpose has been overtaken by something considerably less safe to stand near.
The floor and walls here bear the marks of a hazard that's still active, {adj} as it's become with age.
rest-area: A {adj} alcove, quiet enough that it's clearly been used as a waypoint by more than one previous expedition.
This small chamber is {adj} but defensible - a rare pocket of calm in the {domain}.
chamber: A {adj} room, unremarkable at a glance but part of the {domain}'s larger pattern all the same.
Another {adj} chamber in the {domain}, its purpose only clear in context with what's around it.

hazardTemplates.text: A pressure plate near the threshold triggers a hidden mechanism unless disarmed (DC {dc} to notice, DC {dc} to disarm).
The floor here is unstable and gives way under careless weight (DC {dc} to notice before stepping wrong).
A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC {dc} to detect and counter).
A residual effect lingers in the air, growing worse the longer anyone stays without taking precautions (DC {dc} to resist each round).

encounterTemplates: Roll a random encounter check when the party lingers here more than a few minutes - something has noticed them.
A patrol or wandering hazard tied to the floor's threat passes through this area on a rotation; a failed Perception check meets it head-on.
This room refills with a new threat if left and returned to later, on the same table used for the floor's other random encounters.
